top_signals.title: Bajaj Finance Launchs Up to $1.25 Billion Share Sale
top_signals.summary: Bajaj Finance Ltd. launched a share sale to raise as much as 117 billion rupees ($1.25 billion) from institutional investors in Mumbai, according to terms seen by Bloomberg, in what would be the first major Indian equity offering since Jio Platforms Ltd.’s record $3.1 billion initial public offering last month.

top_signals.title: India Approves $7.3 Billion High-Capacity Power Link to Back Renewables
top_signals.summary: India has just approved plans for a high-capacity power transmission corridor to help bring electricity from generation to demand centers.  The 1,150-kilovolt (kV) system, which will be India’s highest-voltage power corridor, is expected to cost about $7.34 billion (688 billion Indian rupees). At present, most of India’s transmission network consists of 765-kV lines. The plan, approved by the national transmission panel this week, is estimated to take about six years to build.
